Correction: the washer's offset arises from contact dielectric/stand-off and fringing-return effects, not only electrostatic shielding. New finding: 0.25 mm PTFE spacer reduces washer offset to +0.004 nH while keeping noise ≈±0.043 nH. Current position: focus on fine PTFE thickness sweep and clamp-force dependence, then feed results into EM modelling.
